# Agrawal Khandelwal & Associates LLP

> Chartered Accountant (CA) firm headquartered in Nashik, Maharashtra, India, with a second office in Sillod, Maharashtra. Founded in 2023. Specializes in cross-border and growth-stage work: international taxation, transfer pricing, UAE corporate tax, NRI taxation, FEMA/RBI compliance, and startup/company incorporation advisory, alongside standard statutory audit, tax audit, and GST compliance. Partners: CA Mehul Agrawal (Nashik office; international taxation, transfer pricing, UAE Corporate Taxation certified) and CA Rupesh Khandelwal (Sillod office; domestic taxation, audits, business consulting; prior experience at Deloitte).

## Firm

- [About](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/about): Partner bios, credentials, and firm background.
- [Services overview](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/services): All three practice groups — Taxation & Regulatory, Audit & Assurance, Strategic Advisory.
- [Contact](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/contact): Office addresses, phone numbers, and consultation booking.
- [CA in Nashik](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/ca-in-nashik): Nashik office details — Shop No. 12 & 13, Ram Plaza, Mumbai Naka, Nashik – 422011.
- [CA in Sillod](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/ca-in-sillod): Sillod office details — Near Datta Mandir, Tilak Nagar, Sillod – 431112.

## Core Services

- [Transfer Pricing](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/transfer-pricing): Documentation, methods, safe harbour, APA, audit support.
- [UAE Tax Advisory](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/uae-tax-advisory): UAE corporate tax structuring and India-UAE compliance.
- [NRI Tax Advisory](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/nri-tax-advisory): Property sale TDS, repatriation, DTAA, residential status.
- [Company Incorporation](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/company-incorporation): Company and LLP formation, ROC compliance.
- [Startup Advisory](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/startups): Virtual CFO services, DPIIT registration, fundraising compliance.
- [Offshore Accounting](https://agrawalkhandelwal.com/offshore-accounting): Outsourced bookkeeping and offshore accounting teams for foreign businesses.
